Search filter on /api/export/barang-masuk/excel actually filters rows. Legacy progres cleanup (empty po_id) confirmed via /rekap/progres returning no orphan rows.

minor.issue: backend_test.py::TestProgres::test_update_progres_staff now fails because it POSTs without po_id → server can't look up qty_masuk → falls back to 0 → packing capped at 0 (was 5). This is EXPECTED given iter3's packing cap + iter4 legacy cleanup. The iter1 test is stale; either (a) update it to include po_id, or (b) delete the test. Not an iter4 regression — code behaves per spec.

issues: Layout minor: the print:hidden class is on the top flex wrapper (line 110), but the 'add-staffing-button' Dialog is rendered OUTSIDE that wrapper (line 120), so on print it might still render its trigger; harmless because @media print button {display:none} in index.css, but semantically inconsistent with BarangMasuk.jsx which nests the Dialog inside the print:hidden wrapper.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update or remove stale /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestProgres::test_update_progres_staff — it posts progres without po_id and expects packing=5, but packing is now correctly capped at qty_masuk (0 when no barang_masuk exists). Either add po_id + a barang_masuk to the fixture, or delete this old test.
OPTIONAL (cosmetic): Move the Staffing 'add-staffing-button' Dialog inside the print:hidden wrapper for parity with BarangMasuk.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1549 lines — the guideline recommends <700. Splitting into resource routers (auth, barang, po, bm, staffing, progres, spk, rekap, exports, users) via APIRouter modules is overdue.

_excel_with_images (line 1382): image fetch uses synchronous get_object/PIL inside an async endpoint — for large staffing/barang-masuk exports with many images this will block the event loop. Consider running via asyncio.to_thread or a threadpool executor.
export_all_bm_pdf & export_all_staffing_pdf iterate over db.barang_masuk.find({}).to_list(1000) and then per-item _fetch_image_flowable — same event-loop concern.

Search filter in export_all_bm_pdf & export_barang_masuk_excel_v2 concatenates no_po+penerima as one lowercase blob (line 1427/1491) — an input like search='N100' could accidentally match a penerima that has 'N100' inside; low risk but slightly loose semantics. Consider matching each field independently.
GET /api/rekap/staffing-summary iterates POs × staffing × items in Python (line 1364-1378) — same N×M×K concern; migrate to MongoDB aggregation with $lookup when data grows.

Startup legacy cleanup (line 240-244) runs UNCONDITIONALLY on every server start. On a busy DB with 100k+ progres rows, count_documents({po_id: ''}) does a full collection scan. Consider adding a partial index on po_id or gating cleanup behind a version marker in a `_migrations` collection.
No unique index on (po_id, item_id) in progres collection — repeated POSTs with same key upsert correctly today, but a compound unique index would enforce it at DB level.
